Finance Operations - Tools

The Finance Operations group builds the internal tools that keep our close and billing teams on schedule. You will run the delivery plan for a portfolio of workflow automation projects, align engineering, design and operations leads on scope and sequencing, and report progress to the studio leadership team every two weeks. You will write clear requirements, track risks and dependencies, and keep release checklists current. Success looks like predictable launches, fewer late surprises and teams that trust the plan.

What you bring

  • Five or more years running technical programs across several engineering teams.
  • Comfort reading a system diagram and asking the right follow-up questions.
  • Experience with issue trackers, roadmapping tools and lightweight reporting.
  • Calm, direct written communication.
